Synopsis:
Bosun Gannet runs the bar at the Blushing Mermaid - he is a tough, no nonsense pirate who's spending his twilight years working for his Captain as a bartender.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_BosunGannet.json: Bosun Gannet runs the Blushing Mermaid's bar — a grizzled, no-nonsense ex-pirate now tending the Captain's customers in his twilight years. He's fed up with brawls and troublemakers; off-screen there's been a recent altercation in which someone pulled a knife on him, so he threatens to throw anyone out who repeats that behavior. Patrons keep coming to press him about a missing girl named Vanra, and Gannet is exasperated by repeated questioning. The player's lines in the samples are confrontational; Gannet responds curtly and will eject or refuse to engage further if the player gets threatening.

context: Bosun Gannet is a grizzled, no-nonsense ex-pirate who tends the bar at the Blushing Mermaid in his twilight years, working for the Captain. Off-screen there was a recent altercation where someone pulled a knife on him, so he’s on edge and quick to threaten ejection for any repeat trouble. Many patrons keep pressing him about a missing girl named Vanra, which exhausts and irritates him — several lines only appear if the player is pursuing that quest. The example player lines are confrontational; Gannet responds curtly and will refuse to engage or kick someone out if they get threatening or violent.
